record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation: HCFCs were introduced as temporary substitutes for chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs), the earlier refrigerants named by the stem. The EPA notes HCFCs still harm stratospheric ozone, though less than CFCs. Thus CFCs completes the historical replacement relationship; this does not mean HCFCs are ozone-safe.
